titles: 석촌호수는 정말 사람이 판 호수일까? (feat. 잠실은 섬이었다?)

image_concepts.A: 컨셉 A(추천). 석촌호수 두 호수 항공 실사 + 호수 양끝으로 이어지는 반투명 옛 강줄기. 호수와 강줄기가 화면 50~70%, 사람 없음.
image_concepts.B: 컨셉 B(문구 3번용). 서호 언덕의 삼전도비를 화면 절반 크기로, 그 너머 호수 수면. 사람 없음.

edits: 호수와 옛 강줄기가 이어지는 지점에 빨간 손그림 동그라미 1개
컨셉 B 변형(4번)은 수면 한 점에 빨간 화살표 + 흰 손글씨 「원래 자리」
실제 옛 지도·항공사진(송파구청 공개 자료 등)을 확보하면 AI 이미지 대신 그쪽을 우선 — 실사 고정 규칙에 더 맞는다
meta.note: channels/science/config/thumbnail-strategy.json fixed_layout(실사 고정, 하단 40% 글자 자리, 빨간 동그라미 1개) 기준. 005·007의 누수 단면도 구도는 선점돼 쓰지 않는다

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A(추천). 석촌호수 두 호수 항공 실사 + 호수 양끝으로 이어지는 반투명 옛 강줄기. 호수와 강줄기가 화면 50~70%, 사람 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic aerial photograph looking down at an angle over Seokchon Lake in Jamsil, Seoul: the two lake halves (east lake and west lake) split by a wide boulevard, with Lotte World Tower rising at the edge of the frame. A wide, ghostly translucent turquoise river channel continues out of both ends of the lake and flows across the surrounding city blocks, as if the old river were still visible beneath the city. The lake and the old river channel together fill 50 to 70 percent of the frame, placed in the upper part. No people. Bright clear daylight, curious mood, muted grey city with the water as the vivid accent. Real photograph look, sharp focus on the lake. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형. 벚꽃철 석촌호수 위로 호수보다 넓은 옛 강줄기 띠. 산책객은 보이지 않을 만큼 작게.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high aerial view of Seokchon Lake in Jamsil, Seoul in cherry-blossom season: pink blossom-lined walking paths ring both halves of the lake, Lotte World Tower stands at the edge of the frame. A broad, faint translucent blue band of an old river runs straight through the lake and onward across the city blocks on both sides, clearly wider than the lake itself. The lake and the river band fill 50 to 70 percent of the frame in the upper part; walkers are too small to see. Soft daylight, sense of discovery. Real photograph look, vivid but realistic colors. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B(문구 3번용). 서호 언덕의 삼전도비를 화면 절반 크기로, 그 너머 호수 수면. 사람 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic photograph of the Samjeondo Stele, a tall dark stone monument on a carved stone turtle base, standing on a small green hill beside the western half of Seokchon Lake in Seoul. The stele fills the left and center of the upper frame, about half of the image; behind it the calm lake surface stretches away, with Lotte World Tower faint in the distance. No people. Late spring daylight, quiet curious mood. Real photograph look, sharp focus on the stele. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형. 비석이 선 언덕에서 서호 북동쪽의 탁 트인 수면을 내려다본 장면 — 수면이 주인공, 비석은 구석에 작게. 편집에서 수면 한 점에 빨간 화살표 + 「원래 자리」.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic photograph from the edge of a small green hill beside the western half of Seokchon Lake in Seoul, looking out over a wide stretch of calm, open lake water toward its northeast corner. The plain water surface fills 50 to 70 percent of the upper frame, with nothing built on or under it; a tall stone stele stands small in one lower corner of the hill. No people. Soft daylight, calm and curious mood, green and grey tones with clear blue water. Real photograph look. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드. 1971년 송파강 물막이 — 강을 가로질러 막은 흙둑과 그 너머 섬의 밭, 빛바랜 기록사진 톤. 사람·차량 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic faded color archival-style photograph from the early 1970s in Seoul, seen from slightly above: a long fresh earthen embankment stretches across a wide river channel and closes it, with still water on one side and flat sandy island farmland beyond. The embankment and the river fill 50 to 70 percent of the upper frame. No crowds; no people or vehicles in view. Slightly washed-out 1970s film colors, sense of a historic moment. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.
